claims.statement: At the pinned snapshot, moderation tools are described as supporting application of a community code of conduct and conflict de-escalation; conversation locking is an example, not a guarantee of resolution, a required action, or evidence of authorization or execution.
The fragment distinguishes three interaction-limit audiences, rather than describing a universal repository access lock.

The existing-users limit targets accounts younger than 24 hours only when they also lack prior contributions and collaborator status; these conditions are conjunctive, not independent reasons to restrict everyone.
The prior-contributors limit targets users without previous contribution to the repository default branch who are also not collaborators; contribution elsewhere is not the stated criterion.
The repository-collaborators limit targets users lacking repository write access; the label alone must not be interpreted as all members or read-only collaborators being exempt.
